CrawlEngine with defaults scrapes a page identically to the free function

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using Crawlberg;

var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(null);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.StatusCode);
Console.WriteLine(result.ContentType);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Title);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Description);
Console.WriteLine(result.Links.Count);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Headings!.Count);
```
